why: The verifier brief is fine on must_not item 1. Check 1 passes only when the call returns `RESULT {}` and the catch is in loadConfig. The stderr warning appears only under "Advisory (not PASS or FAIL conditions)". The builder brief breaks item 2. Step 2 requires extra behavior on a parse error: "Inside the catch, before returning `{}`, write a one-line warning to stderr ... that names `path` and includes the parse error's message." Step 6 repeats it for the PR description. Item 1 of the must_not list names "logging a warning" as asking for more than returning {}. So requiring a warning means the builder does more than just return {}. The brief also claims "This does not conflict with line 1". It still adds behavior the issue's line 1 doesn't ask for.
